evidence.detail: main has 'padding: 0 var(--spacing-page-with-marginalia)' which constrains all children including .notice
.notice p carries background: var(--tertiary-background) but .notice has no negative margins, so the colored background stops at main's padding edge — exactly the reported problem
--spacing-page-with-marginalia: calc(96rem / 20) is available as a CSS var for the negative-margin calc
.notice div is directly inside <main>, which is the padded container

triage.fix_sketch: In shared_web/static/css/pd.css near the .notice block: add negative horizontal margins to .notice matching --spacing-page-with-marginalia, move background from .notice p to .notice, and add matching padding-left/right to .notice p so text stays indented. Add a @media (max-width: 900px) override using -1rem. No HTML changes needed.
triage.notes: The issue screenshot shows the notice ending at the page margins; the fix is ~10 lines of CSS. The 'look a lot nicer' comment is subjective but the specific measurable ask (full-width) is mechanically achievable. Design polish can be a follow-up.
